instrument: Grant County PUD published load limit and Quincy Transmission Expansion Plan
summary: The Quincy-area load limit is 372 MW, rising to 750 MW on completion of a $260 million transmission expansion scheduled for 2029. Grant PUD holds more than 2,100 MW of generation and recorded a July 2026 peak load near 1,050 MW.

source.citation: grantpud.org pages via search index, page updated May 6 2026; grantpudqtep.org

notes: The Quincy Transmission Expansion Plan comprises six transmission line segments of 1 to 32 miles, one new switchyard, expansion of the Mountain View substation and expansion of the Wanapum switchyard. The anchor segment is a 32-mile 230 kV line from Wanapum switchyard to Mountain View substation. Generation headroom and deliverable load are different quantities: the utility holds more than twice its July peak in generation while the Quincy area limit sits at 372 MW.
